experiment: JOB CPU pilot v1; fixed estimated inputs; no quantum hardware
timeout_policy: Stop repeating a physical plan after its first timeout; record all unrun scheduled repeats explicitly. Never substitute the timeout cap for a completed runtime.
guard_policy: Fallback on failed validation or candidate estimated Total Cost greater than cached default cost. Evaluate offline using shared plan medians; do not label this a measured guarded end-to-end policy.
timing_policy: One warmup per physical plan per timing session, then five randomized blocks with the default baseline in every block; verify tree and physical hash on every execution.
encoding_policy: Build once per query from fixed estimated filtered base/pair inputs, save BQM, then independently sample 30 seeds. Encoding is not charged anew to each solve.
